children: NEW YORK, Sept 3 (Reuters) - The amount of U.S. commercial paper contracted in the week ended Sept 2 Federal Reserve data showed on Thursday.    U.S. seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding fell $5.9 billion to $1.441 trillion in the latest week.    Non-seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding - which some analysts consider a more reliable reading than the seasonally adjusted one since it has been distorted by the financial crisis - fell $11.8 billion to $1.454 trillion.    U.S. non-seasonally adjusted foreign financial commercial paper outstanding fell $6.3 billion to $352.7 billion.
